scope: Investigation only; existing extension functions and unchanged formats. SQL builds are end-to-end. Native core builds use the same sorted unique even keys in a separate process, with all partitions resident; query routing uses top bits. Core array-byte accounting excludes allocator overhead; RSS is whole process. Payload sums exclude future composite headers. Native build_s excludes text parsing; total_build_s includes two passes, but not DuckDB preparation. SQL profiles can miss transient scratch; recorded process RSS and memory-limit failures are independent evidence. Paths normalized; unrelated optimizer/parser profile detail omitted.
